body: The development stage did not update the statuses. The technical specification (Scheduled checks around a Refresh price, "Development stage", and the Files to change table) says it sets FR-TEST-HYG-033–036 and TS-TEST-HYG-038–043 to implemented. The development commit 4bd4a63 only touches state.json, so the PR merges with `FR-TEST-HYG-033–036 specified (issue #182)` here, `TS-TEST-HYG-038–043 ready (issue #182)` in doc/specifications/test-suite-hygiene/technical.md line 3, and `FR-TEST-HYG-033–036 specified (issue #182, …)` in the Test suite hygiene row of doc/FUNCTIONAL_SPECIFICATIONS.md (line 358). Every earlier issue in this spec (#181, #185, #238, …) is recorded as implemented after its merge. Fix: change the three status texts to implemented.

The header comment contradicts itself. It says "TC-001 to TC-003 are in TestAmazonHumanChecks_TC032_…" and then says TC-002 is a check recorded in no-tests.md. TC-002 is a mutation check, not a part of TC-032 (testcases.md, no-tests.md). Fix: "TC-001 and TC-003 are in TestAmazonHumanChecks_TC032_NoDuplicateCheckWhileOneIsRunning; TC-002, TC-005 and TC-006 are checks recorded in the change folder's no-tests.md."

no-tests.md says "The scratch files are listed in `delete.txt`", but the change folder in the PR has no delete.txt (the pipeline consumed it), so a reader cannot follow the reference. The method also differs from the technical specification, which says the tests stage reverts each mutation with Edit and checks `git diff --quiet master -- internal/service/service.go internal/service/amazon_gate.go`. The `go test -overlay` approach is fine and leaves production files untouched. Fix: drop the delete.txt sentence, or say the scratch overlay files were removed after the run.
